description: Requirements elicitation, discovery interviews, and creating or evaluating Product Owner Specifications that document business requirements before architecture design: "PO spec", "elicit requirements", "business context intake", "evaluate PO spec". Scores a spec against the readiness rubric, runs gap interviews on weak areas, and writes PRODUCT_OWNER_SPEC.md plus a distribution PDF under exports/. Run this before architecture-docs Workflow 1 — the PO Spec gate reads its output. Also keeps the spec current once the architecture evolves: "update the PO spec", "sync PO spec", "actualiza el PO spec" — a delta collected by code from the changelog, the ADRs and the flows, proposals in business language, the Product Owner's approval item by item, a sync marker.
